messages:
riley: starting v2026.3 rollout -> us-east canary 5% for 20m, change window until 13:00 UTC. watching p95, error_budget burn, and SLO heatmap https://dash.internal/redwood/slo/us-east :spiral_calendar:
deploy-bot: deploy started: v2026.3 -> us-east (canary=5%) | job=release-orch | id=dep-20260321-92 :robot_face:
tasha: trace sampling currently 1% on canaries. bumping to 15% so we get stacks on failures
sam: small 429 blip on /api/generate in us-east-west shard, about 0.6% -> 0.9% in last 3m. p95 steady. could be limiter or autoscaler lag
riley: increasing tracing to 15% and enabling rate-limit debug logs on canary pods (will narrow to canary-only)
infra-bot: alert: us-east /api/generate 429 rate 0.9% (threshold 0.8%) — triggered at 1818305588. incident: https://incidents/redwood/INC-20260321-12 :rotating_light:
tasha: pulled logs from a canary pod: `limiter.go:48 WARN request dropped: rate=1.23 threshold=1.0` plus one OOMKilled on pod canary-3
sam: sounds like a limiter config regression or an autoscaler race on the new image. proposal: pin us-east back to v2026.2 while we investigate. keep canary in other regions
riley: agree. will apply routing pin. rollback only if 5xx or 429 > 1.0% sustained for 10m
deploy-bot: traffic pin applied: us-east -> v2026.2. change id=route-pin-8112. canary continues in eu-main and ap-south
release-desk: noted for release notes: "v2026.3 partial rollout; us-east pinned to v2026.2 due to /api/generate 429 spike and limiter/autoscaler interaction. follow-up tickets for autoscaler and limiter config." :memo:
infra-bot: alert cleared: us-east 429 back to 0.18% at 1818305715. auto-note: incident auto-resolved after routing pin
sam: filing two follow-ups: RH-4578 limiter threshold diff + RH-4579 autoscaler cooldown investigation. adding sample traces to canary evals
riley: marking deploy held for us-east; proceeding with rest of rollout. will resume us-east after fixes and 45m soak. thanks all :thumbsup:
